findings.title: Invalidate connected calendar queries after deleting cache
findings.body: The cache deletion success handler only invokes the optional onSuccess callback and never invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. The wrapper displaying cacheUpdatedAt owns that query but merely forwards props.onChanged, which is optional and does not guarantee a refetch; it also disables refetchOnWindowFocus. Consequently, after a successful deletion the dropdown can continue showing the old cache timestamp and offering deletion of data that no longer exists. Invalidate the connected calendar queries on successful cache deletion, as the disconnect mutation already does.
